title: Python Core & Advanced Programming Mastery Test
description: Test your mastery of Python data structures, decorators, generator expressions, and complexity.

questions.question: What is the average time complexity of looking up a key in a Python dictionary?
questions.explanation: Python dictionaries are implemented as hash tables, providing average O(1) time complexity for lookups.

questions.question: What is the primary memory advantage of a generator expression over a list comprehension?
options: Generators store elements in binary format
Generators evaluate items lazily on-the-fly, consuming constant O(1) memory
Generators automatically cache results on disk
questions.explanation: Generators yield items one at a time using iterator protocol, avoiding memory allocation for the entire collection.

title: Generative AI & Transformer Architectures Assessment
description: Assess your knowledge of self-attention mechanisms, LLM architectures, and RAG systems.

questions.question: In the self-attention equation Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax((Q*K^T)/sqrt(d_k))*V, why is the dot product scaled by sqrt(d_k)?
options: To convert the matrix into square form
To prevent large values from pushing softmax into regions with extremely small gradients
questions.explanation: Scaling by sqrt(d_k) prevents large dot products from causing vanishing gradients in the softmax function.

questions.question: Which component is central to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to ground LLMs in private documents?
options: Vector embeddings and similarity search index
questions.explanation: RAG indexes documents as dense vector embeddings and retrieves semantically relevant passages via vector similarity.

title: Modern Physics & Quantum Concepts Test
description: Test your grasp on wave-particle duality, uncertainty principle, and photoelectric equations.

questions.question: Who formulated the hypothesis that light is emitted or absorbed in discrete packets called quanta?
questions.explanation: Max Planck introduced the quantum hypothesis in 1900 to resolve the ultraviolet catastrophe.

questions.question: According to de Broglie relationship (λ = h / p), what happens to wavelength when momentum doubles?
questions.explanation: Wavelength is inversely proportional to momentum: if momentum doubles, wavelength is halved.

title: हिंदी व्याकरण एवं साहित्य ज्ञान परीक्षा (Hindi Test)
description: रस, अलंकार तथा हिंदी साहित्य के प्रमुख कालखंडों पर आधारित ज्ञान परखें।

questions.question: हिंदी साहित्य के किस कालखंड को 'स्वर्ण युग' (Golden Age) कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: कबीर, तुलसीदास, सूरदास और जायसी जैसे महान संतों की रचनाओं के कारण भक्तिकाल को हिंदी साहित्य का स्वर्ण युग कहा जाता है।

questions.question: 'कनक कनक ते सौ गुनी, मादकता अधिकाय' में कौन-सा अलंकार है?
questions.explanation: यहाँ 'कनक' शब्द दो बार आया है और दोनों बार अर्थ अलग है (एक कनक = सोना, दूसरा कनक = धतूरा), इसलिए यह यमक अलंकार है।

title: Advanced English Grammar & Syntax Assessment
description: Evaluate proficiency in conditionals, parallelism, and grammatical agreement.

questions.question: Identify the sentence that correctly exemplifies Third Conditional syntax:
options: If she studies hard, she will pass the exam.
If she had studied harder, she would have passed the exam.
If she studied harder, she would pass the exam.
If she studies hard, she passes the exam.
questions.explanation: Third conditional structures follow: If + Past Perfect, would have + Past Participle.

questions.question: Which of the following contains a dangling modifier?
options: Having finished the experiment, the scientist recorded the observations.
Having finished the experiment, the results were recorded.
After finishing the experiment, she left the laboratory.
Upon concluding the study, they published the findings.
questions.explanation: In 'Having finished the experiment, the results were recorded', the results cannot finish an experiment, leaving the participle dangling.
